QuestInfo.name: How is My Father?
QuestInfo.0: #b#p2154004##k, the girl at the #b#m310050000##k in the Mine, has a favor to ask.
QuestInfo.1: #p2154004# tells you it's been so long since she was captured, and she's curious about how her father is doing. She asks you to deliver a letter to her father. Deliver #t4032767# to #b#p2152006##k.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered the #t4032767# to #p2154004#'s father #p2152006#, the former Council President.

0.0: What? Am I #p2154004#? Yes. I'm #p2154004#. And yes, my father is #p2152006#, the Council President of Edelstein. Why are you asking? Has something happened? Have the Black Wings finally decided to execute me? What? My father wants me to have something?
0.1: Oh, I see. My father tried to send me something, but you couldn't deliver. That's okay. I'm glad to hear that he is doing okay. I've been worried about him.
0.2: Umm, you can go back and forth to town freely right? Do you think you can do a favor for me? I understand that you shouldn't be helping me since you're a member of the Black Wings but... you're the only one who can help me.

yes.0: Oh, thank you so much! You really aren't like the other Black Wings. What? You're not really a Black... Shh! Lower your voice. If the others hear you, they'll lock you up!
yes.1: Be careful not to reveal your identity to the Black Wings. They can be cold and merciless. Cautiously #bdeliver the letter I just gave you to my father#k. I would like to let him know that I am okay.

no.0: I suppose you are right, you shouldn't be helping me. It was foolish of me to ask something of you.

1.0: Ah, you are the one who helped me before. Let me thank you again for what you did. I'm sure #p2154004# received the clothes I sent. What? You don't think so? What do you mean? Do you know something that I don't?

yes.0: This... is a #t4032767#? Have you met #p2154004# inside the mine? Was she okay? Wait, I should read this letter first. Thank you so much for delivering it!

npc.0: Have you not gone to #bfather#k yet? He should be inside City Hall if he is still the Council President.

item.0: I wonder if #b#p2154004##k received the clothes I sent... I wish I had news about her.
